paragraphs: Rav Mari, son of Rav Ashi.
Mentioned in Bava Metzia 103a, but Dikdukei Soferim and the Rosh read “Rav Ashi said,” which Hyman considers more correct.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: דק״ס and רא״ש are read contextually as Dikdukei Soferim and the Rosh in the variant formula, without fresh collation or edition identification.
קג. gives Bava Metzia 103a under the period convention, without independently checked named text.

The replacement Rav-Ashi-said is understood as replacing the heading figure’s attribution there. More-correct retains Hyman’s comparative judgment, not a new adjudication. All three separate Rav titles are full.
